united.name: 3D Reference Organ Set for Female v1.5 (HuBMAP HRA united female), as converted by Female Atlas

registration.method: Pelvis: Horn's quaternion method on the vertex-for-vertex correspondence of the BodyParts3D bones present in both the Female Atlas and BodyParts3D (for the coccyx, the sacrum within 5 cm of its apex). Knees: the HRA menisci centred on the BodyParts3D tibial plateau (its top 12 mm), resting on it and scaled to its width; the cruciate and anterolateral ligaments move with them

changesHere: Selected and merged the source meshes in src/lab/source/structures.source.json; welded coincident vertices; subdivided and smoothed the meshes under 400 triangles; simplified the large HRA meshes with meshoptimizer within 0.4 % relative error; recomputed smooth normals; carried the HRA coccyx, knee ligaments, menisci and female pelvis onto BodyParts3D by correspondence fits; measured the joints, bones and pelvises; translated so the middle of the skeleton's bounds is the origin.
